scope: source paths and address bounds; numerical correctness and compiled transfers require device checks
findings: Read the complete self-contained candidate. Only torch and Triton imports remain; all host tensor operations allocate output or read shape, dtype, stride and element-size metadata.

One program decodes sequence tile, head and batch from its program id. Input offsets use actual qkv strides, bias offsets use actual bias stride; all three Q/K/V offsets stay in the selected head and input plane for valid lanes.
EXACT requires head_dim equal to the power-of-two column tile and sequence length divisible by the row tile. The general branch masks both dimensions on input/output and masks bias columns.
Three output allocations have identical shape and contiguous strides, so sharing the q stride expressions for k and v is valid. Outputs do not alias inputs or each other.
8192-byte tile budget is a resource scheduling constant; grid and branch selection use metadata, without test IDs or data-dependent output reuse. No alternate compute backend or binary helper.
FP16/BF16 Q addition is performed before FP32 scaling in the candidate; full numerical and supplementary tests must validate this order. Codex made no candidate edits.
